SELECT r.reason_code, count(*) AS n, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS dist
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.store_key=12 AND p.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd, count(*) AS n, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.store_key=12 AND p.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, 'Cleaning Products' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
